exposure: Gestational age at birth (preterm 35-36 weeks, term 37-38 weeks)
cohort: 208 newborns delivered by elective caesarean section at 35+0 to 38+6 weeks of gestation in a tertiary hospital from January 2013 to April 2017
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the incidence of respiratory distress between newborns who received antenatal corticosteroids and those who did not.
